name: krw-ontology
description: Source-grounded equity research ontology workflow for 10-K and 10-Q evidence, canonical answer synthesis, and frontend display planning.

interface.shortDescription: Create source-grounded canonical answers and display plans from 10-K and 10-Q evidence.
interface.longDescription: Provides read-only MCP tools and two product skills for KRW ontology research: the runner first calls the research skill to build validated ResearchSynthesis with canonical_answer units from filing evidence, then calls the answer-composer skill to produce a frontend display_plan without rewriting the content.
defaultPrompt: Analyze VG's key risks with canonical answer units.
Compare VG and XOM capex evidence for the web UI.
